title: Job templates
description: Preset create-job fields for the Agent Settlement demo. Clicking a template on /#create fills title, amount, and success criteria. It does not create or fund. Demo only. Not real money.

templates.label: Research brief
templates.title: Research brief
templates.criteria: Three-bullet brief with sources. Cite the last three public filings or equivalent docs.

templates.label: Code review
templates.title: Code review
templates.criteria: List blockers, risks, and one merge decision. Point at files and line numbers.

templates.label: Data extract
templates.title: Data extract
templates.criteria: CSV or JSON of the requested fields only. Note any missing rows. No extra columns.

templates.label: Content draft
templates.title: Content draft
templates.criteria: 800-word draft matching the brief. Include a headline and three section headings.

templates.label: Filing summary
templates.title: Summarize filings
templates.criteria: Three-bullet brief matching the last three filings.
